actions.command:
cat <<'EOF' > plot.py
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Generate data for two groups
group1 = np.random.normal(loc=100, scale=30, size=100)
group2 = np.random.normal(loc=130, scale=30, size=100)

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))

# Create beeswarm plot (swarmplot) with boxplot overlay
# Using seaborn's swarmplot for beeswarm effect
sns.swarmplot(data=[group1, group2], ax=ax, palette=['blue', 'orange'], 
              size=6, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)

# Add boxplots on top
sns.boxplot(data=[group1, group2], ax=ax, palette=['blue', 'orange'], 
            width=0.3, boxprops={'alpha': 0.3}, 
            whiskerprops={'alpha': 0.3}, 
            capprops={'alpha': 0.3},
            medianprops={'color': 'black', 'linewidth': 2})

# Set title and labels
ax.set_title('Beeswarm plot and Boxplots, made with matplotlib', fontsize=14, pad=20)
ax.set_ylabel('Value', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
ax.legend(['Group 1', 'Group 2'], title='Groups', loc='upper right')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved successfully!")
EOF
python plot.py
